pieces:label-value.title: Label & Value
pieces:label-value.description: A domain-neutral label, value, and optional supporting note for summaries, settings, receipts, and detail panels.

pieces:status-line.title: Status Line
pieces:status-line.description: A compact semantic status row with an optional pulse, supporting description, and trailing metadata.

pieces:timeline-entry.title: Timeline Entry
pieces:timeline-entry.description: A numbered timeline entry with title, supporting copy, metadata, and an optional continuation rule.

pieces:media-caption.title: Media Caption
pieces:media-caption.description: An editorial figure caption with an optional index, description, and source credit.

pieces:story-scene.title: Story Scene
pieces:story-scene.description: The shared aspect-aware treatment for characters, places, props, and composed line art on one required named pastel field, with an optional seal reserved for invitations and completion.

pieces:pastel-field.title: Pastel Field
pieces:pastel-field.description: The one flat named-color content field with fixed strength and padding. It groups related content without pretending every section is a card.

pieces:section-header.title: Section Header
pieces:section-header.description: The canonical section introduction: one marker kicker, one clear statement, short support copy, and optional actions.

pieces:action-row.title: Action Row
pieces:action-row.description: A compact arrangement of one primary action and at most one supporting action, built from the canonical Button.

pieces:empty-state.title: Empty State
pieces:empty-state.description: A quiet local empty state with one icon, one explanation, and an optional focused action.

pieces:article-meta.title: Article Meta
pieces:article-meta.description: A compact byline and publication-detail row for author, category, date, and reading time.

pieces:avatar-stack.title: Avatar Stack
pieces:avatar-stack.description: Overlapping avatar group with accessible image labels, fallback initials, optional member callout, and overflow count for proof rows.

pieces:fact-list.title: Fact List
pieces:fact-list.description: One compact wrapping fact row with optional icons for reusable summaries.

pieces:person-meta.title: Person Meta Row
pieces:person-meta.description: Compact person attribution row with optional avatar, name, and role for quotes, cards, and proof sections.

pieces:plan-feature-list.title: Plan Feature List
pieces:plan-feature-list.description: A semantic checklist for plan inclusions with an optional heading and featured-card tone support.

pieces:price-display.title: Price Display
pieces:price-display.description: A compact price lockup for amount, currency, and billing period using semantic color tokens.

pieces:process-step.title: Process Step
pieces:process-step.description: A lean process step with one numbered or icon marker, title, description, and optional plain metadata.

pieces:media-frame.title: Media Frame
pieces:media-frame.description: An image or video frame with one scrim and a content overlay for hero, feature, and campaign compositions.

pieces:inline-stat.title: Inline Stat
pieces:inline-stat.description: The fixed compact value-and-label lockup for proof rows and summaries. Use StatValue directly when the relationship needs different geometry.

pieces:feature-card.title: Feature Card
pieces:feature-card.description: The fixed repeated-capability card. Compose its leading mark and semantic content in markup; the Piece owns only the shared frame and rhythm.

pieces:metric-trend.title: Metric Trend
pieces:metric-trend.description: A flat metric lockup with one delta treatment and an optional sparkline. The owning grid decides whether it belongs inside a card.

pieces:chart-figure.title: Chart Figure
pieces:chart-figure.description: The composable figure around a data plot. Callers provide the header, plot, legend, and interpretation; the Piece owns ruled rhythm and delegates caption semantics to Data Caption.

pieces:kanban-board.title: Kanban Board
pieces:kanban-board.description: One stateless horizontal lane arrangement for grouped work. The Piece owns column rhythm; Blocks or applications own drag, persistence, actions, and business rules.
